reviews.raw_body:
On Wed, 16 Sept 2026 at 20:44, Joanne Koong <joannelkoong@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> Enable large folios, capping the max order at the largest request fuse
> can issue, so a folio always fits within a single request. The order
> range minimum is 0, so under memory pressure the allocator falls back to
> smaller folios.

Applied with all prep patches.

Thanks,
Miklos

2026-09-25.patch_summary: This patch enables large folios in the FUSE filesystem, capping the maximum order at the largest request that FUSE can issue to ensure a folio always fits within a single request. The patch includes benchmarks showing improved performance for various workloads and file systems.
